hydrography_source: Local Surface Drainage Pattern (Channels) During monsoon the rainwater runoff from the mine working area and waste dump are diverted to the mine pits through trenches and garland drains where primary settling of sediment take place. Pumped out water will be diverted into settling ponds and filter beds, where lime & flocculants is added to expedite the sediment settling rate and only clear water is allowed to flow out of mining lease area. Trenches are cleared before the onset of monsoon every year, so that all the water from dumps and mine working faces is diverted to a settling pond. Rivers/ Streams Towards north of the lease, a Nalla flows from east to northwest ultimately joining the main river downstream. There is a perennial river (Cudnem River) is running along the northern boundary of the lease which is one of the tributaries to Madei River. 8
